Corrected terminal accounting: the finite-real regret identity
Original at printed129–130,266–267 / PDF141–142,278–279 ↗
LOCALLY COMPILED CORRECTED FINITE-REAL IDENTITY
Locally compiled and independently production-BODY-reviewed finite-real identity; two compiled public canaries specialize the same core to check a positive gap, nonzero drift and the terminal splice. Full source performance bounds remain open. Unmerged and unpublished.

An arbitrary state type E, total real-valued functions psi and loss on natural time and E, an arbitrary sequence x, comparator u and terminal z, and a natural horizon T>0. No convexity, norm, optimizer, algorithm, probability or causal premise is required. Finite real arithmetic is a specialization: the full EReal/domain adapter remains separate. Indices are zero-based: source round s corresponds to t=s-1. G includes the current loss through t. Only the unscored coordinate T is spliced to z; all y(t)=x(t) for t<T. The original x(T) is unused. The interior drift has indices0..T-2; forT1 it is empty. T0 is not claimed.

MODEL
Exact deterministic accounting for arbitrary states and functions; no algorithmic run is asserted. Indices are zero-based: source round s corresponds to t=s-1. G includes the current loss through t. Only the unscored coordinate T is spliced to z; all y(t)=x(t) for t<T. The original x(T) is unused. The interior drift has indices0..T-2; forT1 it is empty. T0 is not claimed.
ASSUMPTIONS
An arbitrary state type E, total real-valued functions psi and loss on natural time and E, an arbitrary sequence x, comparator u and terminal z, and a natural horizon T>0. No convexity, norm, optimizer, algorithm, probability or causal premise is required. Finite real arithmetic is a specialization: the full EReal/domain adapter remains separate.
ALGORITHM PARAMETERS
T is a positive natural number. u and z are independent arbitrary states; no relation between z and original x(T).
REGRET NOTION
R_T(u)=sum_{t<T}(loss_t(y_t)-loss_t(u)); the scored states are unchanged by the terminal splice.
GUARANTEE
Full equality including every endpoint and drift term. The full EReal adapter, actual optimistic-FTRL/BTRL producers, ghost attainment, support qualification, strong-convex stability, Young estimate and whole corrected7.47/15.31 bounds remain open. A positive arbitrary terminal gap cannot be discarded.

Intuition
The terminal point appears once with a minus sign inside the last within-potential difference and once with a plus sign in the endpoint gap. Their cancellation explains why the scored regret does not depend on an unplayed endpoint.
Why it is needed
One shared algebraic component needed by labeled terminal corrections, not a complete regret theorem or source-container count.
Place in the proof
Finite-real corrected accounting near Theorem7.47 proof, PDF141–142; related Theorem15.31 terminal convention, PDF278–279. The full EReal adapter, actual optimistic-FTRL/BTRL producers, ghost attainment, support qualification, strong-convex stability, Young estimate and whole corrected7.47/15.31 bounds remain open. A positive arbitrary terminal gap cannot be discarded.
Proof and Lean reading notes
Proof idea
Put H_t(v)=sum_{i<t}loss_i(v), so G_t=psi_t+H_(t+1). The regularizer parts of the within-G sum, together with the interior drift, telescope to psi_0(y_0)-psi_(T-1)(z). The cumulative-loss parts telescope to sum_{t<T}loss_t(y_t)-H_T(z). Adding the final comparator regularizer minus the initial played regularizer and the retained G_(T-1)(z)-G_(T-1)(u) leaves exactly the regret. This is the mathematical cancellation argument, not a claimed implementation route.
Lean reading notes
E has no additional typeclass assumptions; psi/loss are real-valued and T>0 is the only propositional premise. The boundary regularizer difference is psi_(T-1)(u)-psi_0(y_0): final comparator regularizer minus initial played regularizer. Local y and G are definitions, not extra hypotheses. The exact Lean header and full-proof source link use the declaration fold; these notes do not claim a complete rendered source-proof graph. Selected actual compiled direct VALUE occurrences are Nat.recAux, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero and Nat.sub_add_cancel. Occurrence does not establish logical necessity or a complete transitive graph; Nat.rec is not the exported direct constant. The source-only AND topology remains distinct from these implementation occurrences. Full source performance bounds remain open. Unmerged and unpublished.

No direct teaching dependency recorded.

panels.foldedExactStatement: theorem finite_regret_identity {E : Type*} (psi loss : ℕ → E → ℝ) (x : ℕ → E) (u z : E) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) : let y : ℕ → E := fun t => if t = T then z else x t let G : ℕ → E → ℝ := fun t v => psi t v + ∑ i ∈ range (t + 1), loss i v (∑ t ∈ range T, (loss t (y t) - loss t u)) = psi (T - 1) u - psi 0 (y 0) + (∑ t ∈ range T, (G t (y t) - G t (y (t + 1)))) + (∑ t ∈ range (T - 1), (psi t (y (t + 1)) - psi (t + 1) (y (t + 1)))) + G (T - 1) z - G (T - 1) u
